title: Baby Lying in Carriage Outdoors, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A close outdoor snapshot of an infant resting peacefully in a vintage deep-hooded baby carriage or pram. A hanging ring rattle toy dangles above the child from the stroller's canopy. The pram is parked outside on patchy dry ground next to a dark wooden fence or wall, reflecting mid-century parenting routines and everyday domestic childhood moments.
